lines.text: What would happen to planet Earth if the Moon suddenly vanished into thin air?
Without the Moon's gravitational pull, our oceans would immediately lose over sixty percent of their tidal range.
Global marine ecosystems would fall into chaos within days, disrupting oceanic food chains.
More dangerously, the Moon acts as a cosmic stabilizer keeping Earth's rotational tilt steady at twenty-three degrees.
Without it, our planet would violently wobble like a dying top, flipping climate zones unpredictably.
The Sahara could become an icy tundra while Antarctica turns into a scorching desert.
So every time you look at the Moon, thank it for keeping our world stable.
